# Ryan H. Kim

> Undergraduate student at Yale University studying Computer Science, Mathematics, and Global Affairs. AI researcher, co-president of AttentionX (Korea's leading AI research group and startup accelerator), and currently serving as a Military Police Sergeant (KATUSA, 31B) with the US Eighth Army at USAG Humphreys, South Korea.

Ryan Hwang Kim is a driven, creative, and analytical thinker deeply interested in AI and emerging technologies — both the technical frontier and the societal and business implications. He has co-authored research appearing in *Nature* and at NeurIPS 2024, and has worked at the Center for AI Safety, KAIST CLVR Lab, and as a Global Youth Advisor for Google & Canvas8.

## Contact

- Email: ryan.h.kim@yale.edu
- Website: https://ryanhwangkim.com

## Education

- [Yale University](https://www.yale.edu) (Sep 2023 – present): B.S. Computer Science + Mathematics, B.A. Global Affairs. On leave from Fall 2024 through Spring 2026; returning as a sophomore in Fall 2026.
- [Choate Rosemary Hall](https://www.choate.edu) (Sep 2019 – May 2023): High School Diploma.
- [Dulwich College Seoul](https://www.dulwich-seoul.kr) (Sep 2010 – May 2019): Elementary and Middle School.

## Experience

- **Stealth — Founder** (Apr 2026 – present): building at the intersection of AI and humanity.
- **[AttentionX](https://www.attentionx.org) — Co-President** (Jan 2025 – Jun 2026): Korea's leading AI research group and startup accelerator.
- **United States Eighth Army — Military Police Sergeant** (Oct 2024 – Apr 2026): KATUSA MP (31B) with HHC, USAG Humphreys. Recipient of the Army Commendation Medal.
- **[KAIST CLVR Lab](https://clvrai.com) — Part-time Undergraduate Research Intern** (Dec 2024 – Mar 2025): Reinforcement learning and robot learning research with Prof. Joseph Lim.
- **[Center for AI Safety](https://www.safe.ai) — Research Engineer Intern** (May 2024 – Jul 2024): Co-authored *Humanity's Last Exam* (Nature) and *Safetywashing* (NeurIPS 2024).
- **Google & Canvas8 — Global Youth Advisor** (Feb 2024 – present): Pre-release beta testing and ideation for AI-powered products.
